comment: EPISODE 5 — THE HAND OF GOD (Quarter-final stage, ~5-6 min). Real data: last 8 = ARG/FRA/NOR/ENG/ESP/BEL/MAR/SUI; Golden Boot Messi 8, Mbappe 7, Haaland 7, Kane 6; Ronaldo & Vinicius OUT. Maradona is one of the three witches (Hand of God). Haaland vs Kane QF duel -> cliffhanger bust (no named loser). Soccer only, our-prediction not fact, free-to-play no prizes.

lines.text: Sixty-four teams became eight. Six legends became four. And the board has never been hungrier.
One by one, the fallen are dragged into the dark.
Ronaldo. Caged, then freed, then gone. Portugal, swallowed whole.
The son of Brazil, devoured. Brazil, erased from the last eight for the first time in history.
Only four kings remain. And tonight, the board demands a sacrifice.
Who scores his way to the throne? And who feeds the dark?
Three rounds crowned Messi, and threw Ronaldo into a cell.
Witches stirred the dark, and Pele, the King, freed the prisoner.
A coin of fate erased Dembele. And the board revealed its only law: score, or fall.
Now the knockouts have begun the cull. Eight teams left. Four legends standing.
Argentina, two goals down, staring into the abyss.
And then... Messi.
Three strikes in twenty minutes. The board erupts in gold. Eight goals, and the lead is his.
Far in the north, the Vikings rise.
A wall of horns and thunder, chanting for their giant. Roo! Roo! Roo!
And Haaland answers them.
A brace to devour the son of Brazil. Seven goals, and Brazil is gone.
Mbappe, ice in his veins, buries it from the spot. Seven of his own.
And Kane, nerve of steel, keeps England alive. Six, and climbing.
Four kings. Four towers of gold rising from the board.
Messi, eight. Mbappe, seven. Haaland, seven. Kane, six.
Two goals cover them all. And only eight teams are left alive.
Tonight, the board folds the last eight into four wars.
France meets Morocco. Spain meets Belgium.
Argentina draws Switzerland, and the board smiles upon its king.
But one tie, the board twists into a trap.
England. Norway. Kane against Haaland.
Two of the last four kings, forced onto a single square.
And this cut is real. The loser's nation, gone from the World Cup forever.
One walks to the semis. The other feeds the board.
High above, the three witches lean in to feast.
And then... a hood falls.
The middle witch is no stranger. He wears the number ten.
Maradona. The Hand of God, returned to the board.
The spinning coin was his eye all along. He has watched every single goal.
The King wanted a worthy champion. The Hand wants the game to never end.
And Maradona is torn, for Messi is his blood. His heir.
As Kane and Haaland collide, the sky itself splits open.
A hand of pure light descends over the board.
The Hand of God has not forgotten how to reach into a game.
It spreads over the two kings. One will walk on. One will be dragged into the dark.
The witches hold their breath. Even the King looks away.
The Hand closes... and the board goes black.
The board has chosen its sacrifice. It has simply not yet told them which.
And in the shadows, the King makes his move, his hand hovering over a single token.
Pele is shielding one of the four. But which one... and what is he trading away?
Four kings became three tonight. One Golden Boot. One throne, still empty.
Who fell to the Hand of God? Haaland, or Kane? That one is yours to call.
Who tops the boot? Who lifts the cup? Messi? Mbappe? Haaland? Or Kane?

Free to play. For glory alone.

The Hand of God is watching. And the board... is always hungry.
